name: AskYourPDF
summary: AI chatbot for PDFs and websites: train an agent on your documents, chat with them, and embed answers for visitors.
description: AI chatbot for PDFs and websites: train an agent on your documents, chat with them, and embed answers for visitors.

pricing.details: Free 0 € — train on up to 5 documents or websites, 3 visitor conversations a day, up to 100 pages per document, 15 MB max upload, 1 document a day, 50 questions a day, GPT-5 Mini. Premium 14 €/month or 11 €/month billed yearly — up to 10 documents or websites, 50 visitor conversations a day, 2,500 pages, 31 MB, 50 documents a day, 1,200 questions a day, more models (some with credits), knowledge base, summarisation, 10 free credits once, Chrome extension, OCR. Pro 18 €/month or 14 €/month billed yearly — up to 20 documents or websites, 10,000 visitor conversations a day, 6,000 pages, 877 MB, 150 documents a day, 100,000 questions a day, 30 free credits once, plus unlimited ChatGPT plugin questions, longer replies, priority support and priority access to new features. Enterprise is custom (talk to sales).
